title: Instructions for the Church, Widows, Elders, and Slaves

questions.question: Do not rebuke an older man but encourage him as you would a ____, younger men as brothers,
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 5:1 (ESV): "Do not rebuke an older man but encourage him as you would a father, younger men as brothers,"

questions.question: older women as mothers, younger women as ____, in all purity.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 5:2 (ESV): "older women as mothers, younger women as sisters, in all purity."

questions.question: Honor widows who are ____ widows.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 5:3 (ESV): "Honor widows who are truly widows."

questions.question: If a widow has children or grandchildren, let them first learn to show godliness to their own household and to make some return to their ____, for this is pleasing in the sight of God.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 5:4 (ESV): "But if a widow has children or grandchildren, let them first learn to show godliness to their own household and to make some return to their parents, for this is pleasing in the sight of God."

questions.question: She who is truly a widow, left all alone, has set her hope on God and continues in supplications and prayers ____ and day.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 5:5 (ESV): "She who is truly a widow, left all alone, has set her hope on God and continues in supplications and prayers night and day,"

questions.question: But she who is self-indulgent is ____ even while she lives.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 5:6 (ESV): "but she who is self-indulgent is dead even while she lives."

questions.question: But if anyone does not provide for his relatives, and especially for members of his household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 5:8 (ESV): "But if anyone does not provide for his relatives, and especially for members of his household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever."

questions.question: Let a widow be enrolled if she is not less than ____ years of age, having been the wife of one husband,
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 5:9 (ESV): "Let a widow be enrolled if she is not less than sixty years of age, having been the wife of one husband,"

questions.question: Paul advises to refuse to enroll ____ widows, for they may want to marry when their passions draw them away from Christ.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 5:11 (ESV): "But refuse to enroll younger widows, for when their passions draw them away from Christ, they desire to marry"

questions.question: Besides that, they learn to be idlers, going about from house to house, and not only idlers, but also gossips and ____, saying what they should not.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 5:13 (ESV): "Besides that, they learn to be idlers, going about from house to house, and not only idlers, but also gossips and busybodies, saying what they should not."

questions.question: Let the elders who rule well be considered worthy of ____ honor, especially those who labor in preaching and teaching.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 5:17 (ESV): "Let the elders who rule well be considered worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in preaching and teaching."

questions.question: For the Scripture says, "You shall not muzzle an ox when it treads out the grain," and, "The ____ deserves his wages."
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 5:18 (ESV): "For the Scripture says, 'You shall not muzzle an ox when it treads out the grain,' and, 'The laborer deserves his wages.'"

questions.question: Do not admit a charge against an elder except on the evidence of two or three ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 5:19 (ESV): "Do not admit a charge against an elder except on the evidence of two or three witnesses."

questions.question: As for those who persist in sin, ____ them in the presence of all, so that the rest may stand in fear.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 5:20 (ESV): "As for those who persist in sin, rebuke them in the presence of all, so that the rest may stand in fear."

questions.question: Paul tells Timothy to no longer drink only water, but use a little ____ for the sake of his stomach and his frequent ailments.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 5:23 (ESV): "No longer drink only water, but use a little wine for the sake of your stomach and your frequent ailments."

key_verse_text: But if anyone does not provide for his relatives, and especially for members of his household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.
